paragraphs.text: Dark CRT pixel skin for the DSH Web GUI conversation pane
# dsh-pixel-crt
A dark CRT pixel skin for the conversation pane of the DSH Web GUI — hard 2px borders, block shadows
, bitmap headings, scanlines. Scoped to the chat and composer regions only; the sidebar, title bar a
nd other panels are untouched.
> The screenshot is a demo render of the skin on a mock conversation, not a capture of a live sessio
The screenshot is a demo render of the skin on a mock conversation, not a capture of a live session.
## What it does
- Redefines the palette inside `[data-conversation-region="chat"]` and `[data-conversation-region="c
omposer"]`: near-black surfaces, cyan accents, zero border radius. Components that read the `--dsw-a

lias-*` variables follow automatically.
- Adds the pixel furniture: 2px borders, `3px 3px 0` block s

hadows, pressed-state offset, flat code blocks, square scrollbars, cyan caret, pixel selection.
- He
adings and buttons use a bitmap face (`Unifont` / `Zpix` / `WenQuanYi Zen Hei Sharp`, whichever is i
nstalled). Body text stays at the normal 14px and keeps the system font — bitmap faces at small size

s just turn to mush.
- Slight scanline overlay via a repeating gradient.
## What it does not do

- It does not touch the sidebar or any panel outside the conversation.
- It does not change message

layout, spacing or font size. Nothing moves; only the skin changes.
- It is a pure front-end bundle:
no host routes, no config, no state, nothing written to disk.
## Install
[代码示例省略，未执行]
or point the plugin manager at a checkout:
[代码示例省略，未执行]
Then reload the Web GUI. Uninstall by disabling or removing the `dsh-pixel-crt` bundle.
## Why a contrast sweep
Some components hard-code their surfaces in local variables (`--deliverable-fill`) or `color-mix(#ff
f 50%, transparent)` instead of the alias tokens, so a dark palette leaves light cards with light te
xt — usually a file name you can't read. The bundle runs a small, debounced sweep after each render:
if an element sits on a light background *and* its text is light, the background is pushed dark. Da
rk surfaces and dark-on-light cards are never touched.
## Known rough edges

- Small icon-only buttons look chunky at 2px.
- All headings collapse to one size (16px) — the bitma

p face only reads cleanly on a 12/16px grid.
- Scanlines are one CSS rule; delete the `background-im
age` line if you don't want them.
